title: Subterranean Elevation Trench
description: A geographical survey team is analyzing a 2D elevation grid of a mountainous region. They want to find the length of the longest continuous hiking path that moves strictly downhill (from a higher elevation to a strictly lower elevation). From any grid cell, you can move in four directions: up, down, left, or right. You may not move diagonally or outside the grid boundaries.
output_format: An integer representing the length of the longest strictly decreasing path

examples.explanation: The longest decreasing path is [3, 2, 1] or [6, 5, 4, 3]. Another valid path is [3, 4, 5, 6] (increasing), but movement must be strictly decreasing, wait, looking at [3,4,5,6] -> descending is [6, 5, 4, 3] length 4.
The longest path has a single cell of length 1.
